glyph_origin: Zhang (2021): Ideogrammic compound (會意): 亼 (= 今) (“upside-down mouth”) + 心 (“heart”): to listen to one's heart. Original character for 念 (“to think”). Shuowen interprets 今 to be a phonetic component, but the Old Chinese phonetics do not match.
shuowen: Shuowen interprets 今 to be a phonetic component, but the Old Chinese phonetics do not match.
senses: [niàn] to miss; to long for; to think of; to recall
